question: A radar system uses electromagnetic pulses of wavelength $3.0\,\text{cm}$ in air. A pulse is transmitted and the echo from a target is received after $40\,\mu\text{s}$. Taking $c=3.0\times10^8\,\text{m/s}$, determine (i) the frequency of the radar wave and (ii) the distance of the target from the radar.
